outcome: Composite poor outcome (death, sIVH, or PVL)
Need for oxygen therapy at 36-week corrected gestation
cohort: Infants born between 23 and 31(+6) weeks of gestational age between 2001 and 2014 from the Vermont Oxford Network database (n=1575)
finding: After adjusting for confounders, very preterm infants (23-27 weeks) born by cesarean section were less likely to develop sIVH.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower risk of sIVH in very preterm infants (23-27 weeks).
